user.title: Connect to AzuraCast
user.description: Enter the address of your AzuraCast instance. The API key is optional: without it you only get now-playing data; with it you can also manage playlists, the queue and skipping songs.

data_description.url: Base address of your AzuraCast instance, including http:// or https://.
data_description.api_key: Create it in AzuraCast under My Account → API Keys. Use a dedicated user that only has permissions on the stations Home Assistant should manage.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for instances with a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the AzuraCast API key
reauth_confirm.description: AzuraCast no longer accepts the API key for {name}. Enter a new one.

data_description.url: Base address of your AzuraCast instance, including http:// or https://.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty to use the instance read-only.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for instances with a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach AzuraCast at this address.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full address that starts with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This AzuraCast instance is already configured.

data.keep_queue_stations: Keep the queue when a selector changes
data.allow_unavailable_stations: Accept selector values with nothing scheduled now

data_description.excluded_stations: These stations get no device or entities.
data_description.keep_queue_stations: By default, changing a selector clears the upcoming queue so the change is heard after the current song. Stations listed here keep their queue.
data_description.allow_unavailable_stations: By default, a selector value is rejected when none of its playlists can play right now. Stations listed here accept it anyway.
data_description.scan_interval: How often playlists and the queue are refreshed, in seconds.

abort.not_loaded: Load the integration before changing its options.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach AzuraCast to list the stations.

missing_permissions.message: The API key has no management permissions on station {station}.

unknown_option.message: {option} is not a value of selector {selector}.

value_not_available_now.message: No playlist tagged {selector}={value} can play right now.

no_station_targeted.message: Select at least one AzuraCast station.

station_not_managed.message: Station {station} is read-only: the API key cannot manage it.

station_cannot_broadcast.message: Station {station} does not allow skipping songs or clearing the queue: the API key has no broadcasting permission on it.

ambiguous_playlist.message: Station {station} has more than one playlist named {playlist}; use its numeric ID.

sse_unavailable.title: Real-time updates unavailable on {instance}
sse_unavailable.description: Home Assistant could not open AzuraCast's now-playing stream, so song changes arrive up to 30 seconds late. In AzuraCast, turn on "Use High-Performance Now Playing Updates" under Administration → System Settings, then reload the integration.

missing_permissions.title: No management permissions on {station}
missing_permissions.description: The API key used for {instance} can no longer manage station {station}. Give the AzuraCast user permissions on that station, or exclude it in the integration options.

conflicting_tags.title: Conflicting tags on {station}
conflicting_tags.description: These playlists have two values for the same selector, so the selector ignores them: {playlists}. Leave one ha:selector=value tag per selector in each playlist description.

skip_song.name: Skip song
skip_song.description: Skips the song playing on the targeted stations.

clear_queue.name: Clear queue
clear_queue.description: Removes every upcoming song from the AutoDJ queue of the targeted stations.

set_playlists_enabled.name: Enable or disable playlists
set_playlists_enabled.description: Enables or disables several playlists of the targeted stations at once.

playlists.name: Playlists
playlists.description: Playlist names or numeric IDs. An exact name takes precedence over a numeric ID; a name shared by several playlists must be referenced by its ID.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the playlists should be enabled.

reshuffle_playlist.name: Reshuffle playlist
reshuffle_playlist.description: Reshuffles the song order of one playlist.

playlist.name: Playlist
playlist.description: Playlist name or numeric ID. An exact name takes precedence over a numeric ID; a name shared by several playlists must be referenced by its ID.
